notes: «أخيه علي» is one link carrying the name alone (rule 7); the first «علي» in the text is this brother, the later «علي بن الحكم» is a different link.

Layth tells his own encounter («اسْتَقْبَلْتُهُ»), the Imam is only a pronoun, and the reply («أخبرني فلان عن فلان عن عائشة») is a second saying with unnamed transmitters: first-person narrative and a second isnad (rule 11), so the ruling decides the rest.
Nothing in the Kamil route is added beyond Layth.
